Brother '''Rok''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] champion of the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. She issued a challenge, and was subsequently killed alongside other [[White Maw]] champions by an individual.<ref name="Encounter" />
